workspaceConfig.notes: No npm workspaces config. Each package has independent node_modules and builds. Client connects to server via API rewrites in next.config.ts.

rootConfigInfluence.description: Root .gitignore excludes design docs, reference materials, and IDE configs for both packages
Target ES2017, module esnext+bundler, path alias @/* → ./src/*. Determines all client import resolution.
Target es2020, module commonjs, outDir ./dist. Relative import resolution only.
Defines /api/:path* rewrite → NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL. This is the sole cross-package bridge (client→server).
Nodemon config for server hot-reload during development.
Prisma schema generates @prisma/client used throughout all server modules.
ESLint config for Next.js client code quality.

edges.label: REST API via Axios (bridged by next.config.ts rewrites)

bridges.mechanism: Next.js API rewrites (client/next.config.ts) proxy /api/* → server Express routes
bridges.sharedContract: REST API endpoints defined in server/src/routes/*

crossPackageSummary.notes: No shared source packages — client and server are isolated. All cross-package communication is via HTTP. Type definitions are NOT shared; client maintains its own types in client/src/types/.
